content: Table TABREF51 shows the results. “new #10” in the second row indicates an M2M Transformer model trained from scratch on the mixture of six-way pseudo-parallel data generated by VII and the original parallel data. It achieved higher BLEU scores than #10 in Table TABREF33 thanks to the pseudo-parallel data of better quality, but underperformed the base NMT model VII. In contrast, our fine-tuned model VIII successfully surpassed VII, and one more iteration (IX) further improved BLEU scores for all translation directions, except Ru INLINEFORM0 En. Although further iterations did not necessarily gain BLEU scores, we came to a much higher plateau compared to the results in Section SECREF4 .
